population._tuning_notes: garrison = [min,max] per tier; each base rolls a stable target in-range. reinforce: 1 soldier per bunk block per reinforce_minutes, capped at the tier target, paused while enemies are within reinforce_pause_radius of the base center; no bunks = no reinforcement. roam_style column = road-march file between friendly bases within roam_link_blocks; roaming squads despawn if unloaded past roam_despawn_unloaded_minutes. Vostok doctrine: mass — biggest garrisons, biggest columns.
